Main p. 8 / printed p. 7368 reports the distinct n-octadecylphosphonic-acid control at 752.6 mg and 2.70 mmol; its identity is C18H39O3P, not the phosphinic-acid formula. The printed mass/amount/formula do not arithmetically agree under that identity. Preserve this control as a distinct recipe and flag the unresolved basis without recalculation.
